32. The Annual Report of the Council shall include the
Financial statements and accounts, the balance sheet and the
auditor’s report prepared for a period of twelve (12) months
commencing on the ﬁ rst day of April each year and ending

33. All debts and liabilities of the Institute existing on the
day preceding the date of commencement of this Act, shall be
paid or discharged by the body corporate hereby constituted
and all debts due to, and subscriptions and fees payable to
the Institute on that day, shall be paid to the body corporate
for the purposes of this Act.
34  .The  Seal  of  the  body  corporate  shall  not  be  afﬁ xed
